notes: τὸ ἀληθινόν: the supplied nominal 'riches' goes to the article with its determiner, headed on the nominal (rule 102); heading the phrase on 'true' is the reading rule 102 records as corrected.
'commit to … trust' is the frame rendering πιστεύσει, with the frame's supplied noun licensing the preposition so that it stays inside the verb's unit (rule 21); ὑμῖν keeps the possessive.
